name: Ginger Lemon Honey Shot
subtitle: the plain one, and the one most people actually make

steps.text: Blend the ginger with 60ml water until fine.
Strain through a sieve, pressing well.
Stir in the lemon juice and honey until the honey dissolves.

storage: Three days refrigerated in a sealed jar.

provenance.note: Ginger and lemon in hot water is a household remedy across India for a sore throat; taken cold and undiluted it becomes the shot sold in juice bars everywhere.
